info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Etas-v4-spec
info.description: The Rideshare ETA Retrieval API provides real-time estimated time of arrival (ETA) information for rideshare services. By querying this endpoint, users can obtain precise ETAs for rides, helping them manage waiting times and improve overall user experience. This API is essential for rideshare operators, app developers, and logistics companies looking to enhance their service offerings and customer satisfaction. Typical use cases include integrating ETA data into mobile applications and dashboard displays for rideshare management.

get.summary: Retrieve estimated time of arrival for rides
get.description: This endpoint allows you to get the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for a specific ride based on the provided parameters. It calculates the expected arrival time considering current traffic conditions and route details.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving estimated time of arrival (ETA) for rides. This body should contain the appropriate parameters to specify the ride details and location information.

200.description: The estimated time of arrival for the ride was successfully retrieved.
